invention.ref: Schuyler Skaats Wheeler invented the two-bladed electric desk fan in New York
invention.ref_zh: 斯凯勒·斯卡茨·惠勒在纽约发明双叶电动台扇

patent.ref: Wheeler developed electric desk fans manufactured by Crocker & Curtis Electric Motor Co.
patent.ref_zh: 惠勒设计的电动风扇由克罗克-柯蒂斯电机公司转化并投产

mass_production.ref: Crocker & Curtis Electric Motor Company begins commercial mass production of electric fans in New York
mass_production.ref_zh: 克罗克-柯蒂斯电机公司在纽约实现电风扇商业化批量生产

popularization.ref: Fans with guards and oscillating mechanisms become widespread in European and American homes and offices
popularization.ref_zh: 带防护罩和摇头功能的电风扇在欧美家庭与办公室广泛普及

locations.place_label_zh: 美国纽约（惠勒双叶电动台扇）
locations.place_label_en: New York City, New York, USA (Wheeler electric desk fan)

sources.title: Schuyler Wheeler Biography and Electric Fan — Edison Tech Center

summary_zh: 电风扇利用电动机驱动叶片旋转加速空气流动以实现散热降温。1882年惠勒发明电动台扇，随着防护网罩与自动摇头机构的完善，成为夏季最普惠简便的居家用具。
summary_en: Electric fans use motor-driven blades to move cooling air. Wheeler invented the desk fan in 1882; guards and oscillation later made it an affordable, simple household cooling staple.
summary_ja: 扇風機は電動機で羽根を回して空気を送る。1882年に Schuyler Wheeler が卓上扇風機を発明し、後に首振り機構や保護網が加わって、家庭で涼をとるための定番の道具になった。
